what.question: What is MyrmAgent?
what.answer: MyrmAgent is an AI agent platform with a persistent sandbox, memory system, and GUI-first interface. It helps you research, code, and automate tasks without managing infrastructure.

pricing.question: How does Work Units (WU) billing work?
pricing.answer: You see a single Work Units balance. Platform usage — LLM calls, tool execution, and active sandbox time — burns WU according to an internal rate table. You can also bring your own API keys where supported.

local.question: Can I use my own API keys?
local.answer: Yes. Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) is supported — you pay your LLM provider directly for those calls while still using the full MyrmAgent workspace.

data.question: Where is my data stored?
data.answer: Your workspace data stays in an isolated environment under your control — persistent memory, files, and sessions are not shared with other users. See our Privacy Policy for details.

cancel.question: Can I cancel anytime?
cancel.answer: Yes. Subscriptions can be cancelled at any time. Access continues until the end of the billing period. See our Refund Policy for details.

multiAgentOrchestration.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration & Zero-Trust Verification
multiAgentOrchestration.desc: Break the serial bottleneck! Six deterministic modes plus forward-looking zero-trust verification and budget-aware downgrade, eradicating 'hallucinated success' and 'budget burn' pain points.
multiAgentOrchestration.point1: Zero-trust physical isolation: reject blind LLM summaries with enforced physical verifiable credentials; background sandboxes block UI interfaces to protect user chat
multiAgentOrchestration.point2: Smart circuit breaker & budget downgrade: 4D budget controls plus iteration-step hard breakers, auto-downgrading to cheaper models when limits hit; pre-flight cost approval for batch tasks (GUI card shows estimated cost before execution)
multiAgentOrchestration.point3: Seamless Human-in-the-loop (HITL): UI breakpoint approval isn't just accept/reject — approve with inline guidance injection (e.g. 'use production API') that becomes part of agent context; one-click context steering keeps wandering agents on track

dynamicWorkflow.title: Dynamic Workflow Engine
dynamicWorkflow.desc: Compose multi-step agent pipelines at runtime — toggle parallel branches without redeploying scripts.
dynamicWorkflow.point1: SQLite event sourcing: resume after disconnect without re-running completed steps
dynamicWorkflow.point2: Deterministic DAG for production; dynamic workflow for ad-hoc parallel fan-out
dynamicWorkflow.point3: GUI-first authoring — YAML skills and visual control in one workspace

longReportToc.title: Auto table of contents — jump to any section
longReportToc.desc: Long Agent markdown replies get a live chapter index with scroll sync — no copy-paste into Notion for an outline.
longReportToc.point1: TOC appears when there are 2+ headings; H1–H6 hierarchy preserved
longReportToc.point2: Click to smooth-scroll; current section highlighted as you read
longReportToc.point3: No in-chat equivalent in ChatGPT or CLI agents — built into Myrm

webuiSecurity.title: Cloud-Grade Local WebUI Access Control
webuiSecurity.desc: Rejects 'naked' exposure on public networks or tunnels, providing bank-level session control.
webuiSecurity.point1: Underlying WebSocket handshake strong interception, completely eliminating rogue control flows
webuiSecurity.point2: Mandatory password rotation via HMAC signature, instantly kicking out all old sessions upon change
webuiSecurity.point3: Auto-appends Secure flags in HTTPS environments, enterprise security out of the box

toolSecurity.title: Plugins & API guards
toolSecurity.desc: Unified tool entry; plugins and APIs scanned before use.
toolSecurity.point1: Clear plugin scopes; descriptions capped to save context
toolSecurity.point2: External API docs become callable tools; multiple auth modes
toolSecurity.point3: Skill marketplace: 5-source parallel discovery (ClawHub + GitHub + LobeHub + skills.sh + Prebuilt), one-click install, auto-updates

unifiedToolGateway.title: 4-in-1 Gateway & Elastic BYOK Fallback
unifiedToolGateway.desc: One subscription unlocks all top AI tools. Automatically degrades to your own Key if the gateway is unavailable. Strictly protects tokens and prevents UI freezes.
unifiedToolGateway.point1: Built-in LLM, Web Search, Image Gen, and TTS. Zero config out of the box
unifiedToolGateway.point2: True Try-Catch elastic fallback. Auto-switches to local Key on gateway failure, zero business interruption
unifiedToolGateway.point3: Quota Rollover mechanism. Unused quota carries over to the next month
unifiedToolGateway.point4: Financial-grade transmission security. Strict regex validation for PAT tokens with hidden transmission, rejecting log leaks
unifiedToolGateway.point5: Imperative on-demand health checks with 8-second hard timeout, completely preventing frontend blocking and quota waste

productionEngineIntegrity.title: Right engine, right platform — or we refuse to start
productionEngineIntegrity.desc: Proprietary core ships as native modules; every release build auto-verifies before start — you won't discover a missing engine mid-conversation.
productionEngineIntegrity.point1: Dual-package distribution: auditable open product layer, core algorithms not shipped as plain source in images
productionEngineIntegrity.point2: Version and CPU arch must match — fail-fast at startup so ops can fix immediately
productionEngineIntegrity.point3: All release channels share the same verify gate before the agent runs

enterpriseTesting.title: Regression net + hybrid eval engine — not “ship when demo runs once”
enterpriseTesting.desc: Atomic locks, dependency fallback, TOCTOU protection — all covered by targeted pytest + E2E. 17-layer tool interception (7 pre + 10 post) with 1,022 guard tests verified. Built-in hybrid eval engine costs up to 6× less LLM spend than competitors.
enterpriseTesting.point1: Hybrid eval: deterministic assertions (tool/state/sandbox) cost zero LLM calls; semantic judge only when subjective scoring is needed — 6× cheaper than CrewAI’s 6-call-per-case approach
enterpriseTesting.point2: Custom LLM Judge: per-assertion rubric prompt + model override + auto-retry. Full binary + 0.0–1.0 scoring. 122 tests verified
enterpriseTesting.point3: 17-layer tool safety net: every tool call passes through LoopGuard, PII detection, Circuit Breaker, MutationVerifier, Content Validation, TaintTracker & more — 1,022 tests verified. Industry best is 2 layers.

antiBlockingTitle.title: Anti-Leak & Zero-Lag Title Generation
antiBlockingTitle.desc: O(1) early truncation and military-grade redaction pipeline. Zero lag for massive logs, auto-strips sensitive credentials and chatty prefixes.
antiBlockingTitle.point1: O(1) Early Truncation: Eliminates CPU blocking DoS risks from running regex and Shannon entropy on massive texts in the async event loop
antiBlockingTitle.point2: Military-grade redaction & deep denoising: Erases API Keys, strips code blocks, URLs, and HTML tags
antiBlockingTitle.point3: Smart fallback & Prompt isolation: 0-token intercept for empty text, uses `user_input` XML tags to force LLM language adaptation

precisionMultimodal.title: Intent-aware multimodal: vision only when UI actually changed
precisionMultimodal.desc: No blind screenshot spam — the pipeline traces real UI actions and invokes vision only for verification; text-only tasks stay text-only.
precisionMultimodal.point1: Intent-level trigger: filters execution flow so “page open” alone never burns vision tokens
precisionMultimodal.point2: Sandbox-linked capture: framework pulls physical screenshots without flaky HTTP bridges
precisionMultimodal.point3: Up to ~99% fewer vision calls vs always-on screenshot judges — anti-cheat without waste

weSightMigration.title: Cross-platform native + seamless knowledge mesh
weSightMigration.desc: Not a Mac-only desktop console — deploy on Windows/Linux with a shared knowledge mesh and real multi-agent collaboration.
weSightMigration.point1: Cross-platform + WSL probe: detect local external agents and load in one click — no fragile env setup
weSightMigration.point2: Shared knowledge mesh vs isolated mode: inherit memory without fragmentation, with pollution-safe isolation when needed
weSightMigration.point3: P2P agent mesh + mDNS compute discovery: agents interconnect without a single-leader bottleneck
weSightMigration.point4: Tray daemon keeps channels alive: Feishu/WeChat stay connected 24/7 even when the main UI is closed

multiAgentWorkspace.title: Split-Pane Multi-Threaded Workspace
multiAgentWorkspace.desc: Command like a general. Monitor and intervene in multiple sub-agents' independent dialog flows simultaneously via a split-pane/multi-tab workspace.

remoteGateway.title: SaaS-to-Local Remote Execution Gateway
remoteGateway.desc: Control your home PC from your phone. Securely wake up and drive your local Tauri client directly from the SaaS web interface.

globalReviewer.title: Global Consolidation & Review Node
globalReviewer.desc: Perfect delivery, no patchwork. A dedicated Reviewer node at the end of workflows ensures cross-file consistency of all parallel sub-tasks.

resourceThrottling.title: Resource-Aware Concurrency Throttling
resourceThrottling.desc: Max out performance without crashing. Dynamically limits local agent spawn rates based on host CPU/RAM load to ensure absolute stability.

airGappedMode.title: Air-Gapped Local Mode Wizard
airGappedMode.desc: A superbrain that works offline. Built-in network diagnostics and 1-click pairing with Ollama/LM Studio for seamless operation without internet.

skillLifecycle.title: Intent-Guided Context + Deferred Tool Loading
skillLifecycle.desc: 6-layer context compression with intent analysis protects your working files; deferred loading keeps rarely-used tools out of the prompt until needed.
skillLifecycle.point1: Layer 0 intent analysis: active files and modules are shielded before any compression runs
skillLifecycle.point2: Deferred tools: 20+ low-frequency tools load on demand, saving ~4K tokens per turn
skillLifecycle.point3: Skill hot-reload + 14-dimension observability: per-invocation tracking, quality trends, A/B testing, activity heatmap, and Growth Dashboard — all automatic

smartConcurrency.title: Smart Concurrency: Eliminate Race Conditions
smartConcurrency.desc: Intercepts LLM hallucinated parallel file operations, rolling overlapping ops back to a safe serial queue with zero overhead.
smartConcurrency.point1: O(1) path lock resolution without impacting unrelated parallel tool efficiency
smartConcurrency.point2: Granular resource fingerprinting handling deep directories and overlapping read/write
smartConcurrency.point3: Automatically prevents dirty reads, ensuring project-level consistency

headlessZeroDeadlock.title: Headless Agent: Zero-Deadlock Background Tasks
headlessZeroDeadlock.desc: Cron jobs fear interactive hallucination freezes. Myrm isolates interactive tools at the framework layer, eradicating background deadlocks.
headlessZeroDeadlock.point1: Tags logic strips Human-in-the-loop tools instantly during unattended execution environments
headlessZeroDeadlock.point2: LLM operates without knowing the existence of stripped tools, avoiding hallucination errors
headlessZeroDeadlock.point3: Native support for all external MCPs, saving millions of compute costs on cloud-hosted environments

extremeAntiExplosion.title: Long-context shield: chats stay stable
extremeAntiExplosion.desc: Multi-layer recovery, payload guards, and hard budgets — ultra-long multimodal chats without crashes or lost work.
extremeAntiExplosion.point1: Layered recovery: resume, model fallback, image auto-shrink
extremeAntiExplosion.point2: Per-tool loop detection plus token and spend caps
extremeAntiExplosion.point3: Trims redundant images in long chats while keeping what matters

computerUse.title: Production Desktop Automation + Full Visual Tracing
computerUse.desc: Operate desktop apps like a human. 8-layer visual system lets you see what Agent does, where it clicks, and verify results in real time.
computerUse.point1: BrowserLiveView + DesktopLiveView dual panels with real-time screenshots + 14-role BBox element overlay
computerUse.point2: Tauri OS overlay · red highlight frame on real display · multi-monitor auto-match
computerUse.point3: Tree ProgressSteps · Agent badge + duration + progress bar + diagnostics + recovery + LiveTerminal
computerUse.point4: HITL approval · Approve/Deny + edit payload + Monaco Diff review + expiry countdown
computerUse.point5: VNC takeover on stuck + CAPTCHA auto-detect (10 types) · 196 cross-layer tests verified

codexParity.title: Build pages from mockups, auto-verify alignment
codexParity.desc: Upload design → generate code → auto screenshot compare — mismatches highlighted in red, no human or AI guesswork.
codexParity.point1: Screenshot-to-code with 100+ models to choose from
codexParity.point2: Built-in browser engine — no separate Playwright install
codexParity.point3: Millisecond auto-compare page vs design — see exactly what drifted (algorithmic QA, not AI eyeballing)

webSearchFetch.title: Fully Autonomous Hybrid Browser
webSearchFetch.desc: Ditch heavy headless browsers. HTTP short-circuit rendering for static pages, dual stealth engine fallback when blocked, and schema-driven structured extraction.
webSearchFetch.point1: HTTP injection saves 90% memory/latency on static pages
webSearchFetch.point2: O(1) Self-healing, Native Spatial Engine & Shadow DOM recursive piercing — sees through modern web components, no more DOM crashes

security.title: Six-layer runtime guard, approvals & audit you control
security.desc: 7-category semantic DOM risk detection (bilingual) + MCP pre-enable scan + shell per-segment risk coloring + Credential Vault (passwords/TOTP never enter the LLM) + PII redaction + Smart Intent Guard (LLM intent review) + multi-platform HITL approvals with 3-level Allow Always + structured audit trail (37 decision types + Prometheus metrics) — auto-approval prompt on Pay/Delete/Publish clicks, see risk before you allow, trace everything · 781 tests verified.
security.point1: 7-layer operation-level risk management: semantic DOM risk detection (auto-intercept 7 categories: pay/delete/publish/account/admin/share/sensitive) + 4-layer quote-aware shell analysis + Smart Intent Guard + user-configurable Risk Rules + MCP/Skill security scanning + HITL approval middleware
security.point2: MCP security gate + SSRF DNS Pinning (manual redirect loop eliminates rebinding) + shell span approval: `curl | bash` split and color-coded after redaction + auto re-verification after editing
security.point3: Credential Vault + 4-action approval (Approve · Edit · Reject · Always) with 3-level granularity + Approval Guidance Injection (attach instructions like 'use production API' when approving — agent reads it 100%) — passwords stay out of the LLM; ♾️ emoji or `/always` in any channel; no competitor has operation-level risk detection
security.point4: Early Handoff & Visual Verification: smart interrupt and popup help for unrecoverable errors to prevent money burning; CompletionGuard enforces visual and code checks, eliminating half-baked submissions
security.point5: Full GUI automation hooks — SecurityPolicySection (permissions + path rules + PII + natural language policy generator) + RiskRulesSection (custom rules + test panel + match analysis) + CronTriggerEditor (4 trigger types: cron/webhook/event pattern/system event) + per-agent 10+ dimension behavior customization + 6 Agent middleware with KV Cache-optimized injection order — all visual, zero CLI configuration needed; competitors offer CLI-only hooks that users report as 'not easy to use' (211 tests verified)
security.point6: Execution Safety — auto-snapshot before every file mutation (competitors rely on manual git status); LoopGuard with 7 detection algorithms + tool-specific recovery suggestions (repetition, ping-pong, no-progress, output-diminishing, divergence, consecutive-failures, error-signature); FrequencyGuard anti-DoS + cost overrun protection; EStop emergency halt; TerminalErrorRegistry persistent error tracking — zero user intervention, purely infrastructure-level protection (203 tests verified)
security.point7: Error Prevention UX — 4-component code/command copy system (CodeBlock + EnhancedSyntaxHighlighter + clipboardUtils + QuoteToolbar); shell command segment-level risk coloring (safe=blue, unknown=red) with SpanRiskReason tooltips so users understand before approving; CompactedSummaryView editable context summary with archive history + Markdown rendering + i18n; approval card inline editing lets users modify commands before re-submitting — architecture-level protection, not fragile text-tag parsing (742 tests verified)

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how VortexAI ("we", "us") collects, uses, and protects information when you use the MyrmAgent website (myrmagent.ai) and cloud platform.

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.body: We collect account information (email, display name), usage data (Work Units consumption, sandbox activity logs), and payment metadata processed by Stripe. We do not store full payment card numbers.

usage.title: How We Use Information
usage.body: We use your information to provide the service, enforce quotas, improve reliability, and communicate about billing or security. We do not sell personal data to third parties.

storage.title: Data Storage & Security
storage.body: Cloud-hosted user data is stored in isolated per-user sandbox volumes and platform databases with encryption at rest. API keys are stored in an encrypted secrets vault. Local/Tauri deployments keep data on your device.

sharing.title: Third-Party Services
sharing.body: We use Stripe for payments, cloud infrastructure providers for sandboxes, and LLM providers for AI inference. Each provider receives only the data necessary to perform their function.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.body: You may request access, correction, or deletion of your account data by contacting support@myrmagent.ai. EU/UK users may exercise GDPR rights; California users may exercise CCPA rights.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: VortexAI operates the MyrmAgent platform. These Terms govern your use of MyrmAgent, including paid cloud subscriptions billed through Stripe.

acceptance.title: Acceptance
acceptance.body: Using MyrmAgent constitutes acceptance of these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

service.title: Service Description
service.body: VortexAI operates MyrmAgent, an AI agent platform with optional cloud-hosted plans (one-click deploy, we handle ops) and free local/desktop deployments (BYOK). Features and availability may change with reasonable notice.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.body: You are responsible for maintaining account security. One person per account unless using a Team plan. Abuse, credential sharing, or automated account farming may result in suspension.

billing.title: Billing & Work Units
billing.body: Cloud-hosted plans are billed via Stripe on a recurring basis. Work Units are consumed according to platform usage. Unused WU do not roll over unless explicitly stated. Local/Tauri modes are not billed by MyrmAgent. See our Refund Policy for cancellation, refunds, and trial terms.

disputes.title: Billing Disputes
disputes.body: Contact support@myrmagent.ai for billing questions or disputed charges before initiating a bank chargeback. We investigate and respond within 2 business days. Stripe-mediated disputes are handled with subscription and usage evidence on file.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable Use
acceptableUse.body: You may not use MyrmAgent for illegal activity, malware, spam, or attempts to bypass usage limits. We reserve the right to suspend accounts that violate this policy.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.body: MyrmAgent is provided "as is" without warranties. We are not liable for indirect damages. Our total liability is limited to fees paid in the 12 months preceding the claim.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.intro: VortexAI operates MyrmAgent. This Refund Policy applies to MyrmAgent paid subscription plans billed through Stripe.

overview.title: Overview
overview.body: Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled. You may cancel at any time from your account settings or Stripe customer portal.

trial.title: Free Tier
trial.body: The Free plan includes 600 Work Units per month plus a daily refresh. No payment is required. Free tier abuse prevention may apply.

proTrial.title: Pro Free Trial
proTrial.body: The Pro plan includes a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers. Cancel before the trial ends to avoid charges. If not cancelled, the subscription converts to a paid plan and billing begins automatically when the trial ends.

cancellation.title: Cancellation
cancellation.body: When you cancel, your plan remains active until the end of the current billing period. No further charges will occur after cancellation.

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.body: Monthly subscriptions are generally non-refundable once the billing period begins. If you believe you were charged in error, contact support@myrmagent.ai within 7 days.

disputes.title: Payment Disputes
disputes.body: If you see an unfamiliar charge, contact support@myrmagent.ai before initiating a bank dispute so we can resolve it quickly. We respond to billing inquiries within 2 business days. For Stripe-mediated disputes, we submit subscription agreement and usage evidence. Fraudulent chargebacks may result in account suspension.

exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.body: We may issue prorated refunds at our discretion for service outages exceeding 24 hours or duplicate charges verified by our billing team.
